produces: hypothesis statement, target user/JTBD, evidence log, confidence level, next-decision trigger, product record

record_spec.gate_b_contrast: hollow instance: market_size_rationale or competitive_alternatives filled with generic prose that cites no evidence_log entry is schema-conformant but not a real assessment (issue-807 step2 audit).
record_spec.gate_c_finding_method: evidence rigor floor, Mom-Test discipline (Rob Fitzpatrick, The Mom Test, 2013): each evidence_log entry must state an observation/interview count and an approximate date range, and must not rest solely on stated preference or hypothetical response ('would you use X' answers are inadmissible on their own) — the same admissibility rule already carried by this session's user-discovery/market-recon skill directives, now made part of the spec instead of living only in skill prose.

recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)
recomputation.rule: recommendation (go|no-go) must not be asserted before fail_condition, time_box, and decision_rule are populated — pre-registration order (rationale: rule fixed before evidence, never asserted post-hoc).

reference_resolution.rule: evidence_log entries must each resolve to a repo path, commit sha, or a source actually consulted — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

record_spec.source_standard: Cagan/SVPG Opportunity Assessment + lean-startup pre-registered decision rules (Startup Commons / Kromatic / Startup Project)

use_when.board_condition: an issue's requirement is still at problem/hypothesis level AND no product-discovery record with a validated|invalidated verdict exists yet for that issue

use_when: 요구가 아직 문제/가설 수준일 때. 사전등록 가설(지표·임계값·결정규칙)로 스펙 또는 kill 기록을 만든다 (board_condition: an issue's requirement is still at problem/hypothesis level AND no product-discovery record with a validated|invalidated verdict exists yet for that issue)
